description: This posting is serving as an amendment to the Government s loop back to industry for the anticipated Telehealth, Scheduling, & Mobile Platform Services (TSMPS) 36C10B26Q0296 Request for Proposal. The subject action will be solicited as a firm-fixed-price effort issued as a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business set-aside under the General Services Administration Multiple Award Schedule Category 54151S  IT Professional Services .
